title: DAO origin signature value object accepts invalid and mutable field types
description: python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_origin.py::DaoOriginSignature.__post_init__ checks only numeric range and signature length. origin_sequence=True and 1.5 are accepted (True silently serializes as sequence 1; 1.5 fails later in struct.pack), while a 48-character str, mutable bytearray, or memoryview is accepted as signature (str fails later; bytearray can mutate a frozen security value after validation). Enforce type(origin_sequence) is int and signature is immutable bytes (or defensively normalize bytes-like inputs under an explicit contract) before range/length checks. Add constructor and serialization boundary tests for bool, float, str, bytearray, and memoryview.
